critical_code_review_comments: phase1b.py _fulfil() uses 'if case:' before dereferencing case['id'] in the SA_UPGRADE branch, but the log_activity() call above the notify still references case unconditionally in the notify call (case['id'] if case else None) — safe, but consider guarding earlier for clarity.
phase1b.py uses `stripe.error.StripeError` in `payment_status` catch; on newer stripe-python (>=6) prefer top-level `stripe.StripeError`. Not breaking today but forward-compat.
server.py + phase1b.py combined is ~1670 lines; splitting phase1b into services/payments/recommendations routers would improve maintainability.
MTD case creation in _fulfil generates case_ref as `MTD-{2001 + count_of_all_cases}` — collision-prone if any case was ever deleted; recommend a dedicated counter or UUID-based ref.
CORS still allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True (carry-over, deferred).

rca of the issue: None — no bugs found. Two hurdles during live Stripe payment testing that other agents should note: (1) Playwright fill on Stripe Checkout inputs sometimes needs `wait_for_timeout(6-7s)` after DOM ready — the form re-hydrates and short waits cause silent selector failures. (2) By default Stripe Checkout auto-enables the 'Save my information for faster checkout' Link checkbox, which then requires a phone number and blocks Pay; unchecking `input[name="enableStripePass"]` bypasses this. Once those two were handled, the card was accepted immediately, /payment/success rendered, the frontend polled /api/payments/status/{session_id}, backend _fulfil() ran, and the SA package flipped to ELITE with all history/audit/notification side effects intact.
